docs.text: Today's adventure is a trip up the north shore of lake Superior. It's chilly.
False spring beach day! 65 degrees in the windy city!
Beach day. I went swimming in the lake. It was cold.
Froze my ass off at the lake this morning. Totally worth it.
It's a beautiful but windy day at the beach ⛱️ (my umbrella is doing it's best & mostly hanging in there)
Lake Michigan on my morning walk! Lots of ice floes further out! Still glorious even in this weather!
Its a beautiful 7 degree morning at the beach on Lake Michigan. The ice shelf is insane...

Yo! This crummy winter was warm. Spring comes around and it snows?! Oh well. First to enjoy the beach I guess. Hurr. Purely (Lake) Michigan. #puppypride #pupplay #humanpup #gaypup #gaypuppy #puphood #petplaygear #pupcommunity #beach #underwearbulge #speedo #underwear #grungebunnygear #exhibitionism
Lake Michigan waves! Definitely feels like a beautiful early fall day
Evening walksies 🐾 Still cold & windy 🙁 Open water with just a few mini-bergs in the bay. On the other side, the marina ice is breaking up too 😊. Later.
Who needs a trip to Antarctica when we have Lake Michigan in January?
Meanwhile in Chicago a few swimmers are taking a plunge into icy Lake Michigan. I’m shivering just thinking about it 🥶
Taking advantage of a few hours above freezing with a walj to the Montrose Beach ice shelf. Lake Michigan in winter is something to see.
Chicago, yesterday. Watching the ice form on the lake surface was mesmerizing.
I went to the beach right before the snow came in this weekend

39 days until spring 🌱 It was -21°C yesterday, so today's relatively mild temperatures (around -1°C) feel almost tropical Makes me think of all the beach days ahead #blueTue
#rockinTuesday

I took a little trip to the beach today. Sandbanks Provincial Park on Lake Ontario, near Picton, Ontario. The water was cold but I still enjoyed wading around in it. It was sunny, an absolutely gorgeous day.
I am sooo happy the wind is up early, and so are the waves. Gonna be a fun day beach cleaning,eating and bouncing in the waves
Bless Lake Michigan and an easterly wind for blessing up with smoke free air. Hugs to those in N. Wisconsin and Minnesota

It’s getting cold…
Let’s warm up. Show me your #beachlife pix☀️🏖️🐚

Lake Michigan, Chicago, 45°F. Bonus pics of today’s outfit and a gorgeous Japanese china pattern currently at Green Element Resale that someone needs to go rescue because I really do not have the room. There is a ton of it, and it’s truly beautiful.

Went hiking along the beach at lake Michigan yesterday. Not quite weather I'm going swimming in. It was like... upper 60's air temp. And probably upper 50's water temp. I've done it before...but I'm kinda over that now lol.
Took the lad up to the beachfront park in Wilmette today. Chilly and windy, but a perfect brisk fall day... November af.
got to see lake michigan this last weekend with my bf :) super cold, but very beautiful

Being mid-April I took bathing trunks on my trip to the USA. However, at the beach at Manistee North Pier Lighthouse on Lake Michigan the wind-chill was about minus-30° so we went to the opera (yes, there's an opera house in Manistee, which is another story!) #TidesOutTuesday #USA #Michigan #iPhone
Looking out over Lake Superior. Beach day, soaking up some sunshine, and only 1 minute of sketching because it's only 11 degrees.
Cool air + warm sun + a stunningly beautiful lake = another wonderful long run down on Presque Isle.
A cold and snowy day at the beach today
I took my shoes & socks off in -25°C on shores of Lake Michigan & waded into the ice just for the lols. (my crowd was small though)
My fridge now because these were all so good. I had a great time on Lake Superior in October.
Lucked out with the most beautiful weather this long weekend. I even waded pretty deep into Lake Michigan and it felt lovely.
To be honest I was missing my Lake Michigan - but having sunny skies almost everyday is a delight hard to beat
We had some flurries here today, and I do love snow on the beach. Plus I found this giant mama jamma and a little bit of violet #dailylakeglass
It’s been awhile since I left the house - because: sick kid… but this is Lake Michigan beginning to freeze over - last time I saw it
I rarely regret going to the beach in winter. Today was no exception. I'm so blessed to live near Lake Ontario #beach #naturephotography
I just saw a video of people walking on frozen Lake Michigan, in Chicago. When I tell you, Lake Michigan makes Lake Lanier look like a field of flowers!!! I would NEVER play like that!

After the storm. Looking back at my tracks on a frozen Gichigami (Lake Superior). Mooniingwanekaaning (Madeline Island) in the distance. 10 degrees Fahrenheit and "feels like" -1 Fahrenheit, but it feels warmer moving through the snow!

Hundreds, upon hundreds of kids going east past my flat to the beach today. It's going to be 82°. So my walk will definitely be going west today! ( pictures are just a couple of small groups) there have been 20 to 30 kid packs all morning! Ahhh to be young!! #beachday
Frozen Lake Michigan from my flight today. 😍

Found myself at Sugar Beach today during my lunchtime walk. Lots of people out and about here enjoying the 23C November weather. Including this guy "working from home" from the beach. ⛱️ #climatechange

Coldest 4th ever. He took me to Lake Ontario to ask. I sat behind a tree with a turtleneck and sweatshirt on to avoid the cold wind. Bagged it and went into the city to Onondaga Lake where it would be warmer. One of the most polluted lakes in the country. Now that’s romance! 🤣
February 1972, Great Lakes. Holy crap it was cold. I was supposed to go to San Diego.
Our labs love the beach no matter how cold! 🌊🐾🥶 #lakesuperior

In the last 48 hours, we went from playing hockey on Lake Michigan to running in only shorts and a t-shirt, to ice fishing, and now I’m standing in line in the freezing rain for the opening day of the local ice cream place. I love Michigan.
Water at Black Beach is so cold it hurt almost immediately. This numbskull was the bravest member of our family. #minnesota #blackbeach #dogsky
Oval Beach, Saugatuck Michigan, on a chilly afternoon.
I got married up there Augest of 79, went into Lake Superior for a dip, friggin cold as water.

A chilly stroll along Lake Superior.
Water is Life🌊.
40s by Lake Michigan, and it’s basically beach weather

Frozen Lake Superior is quite beautiful. It's pretty cold and very windy, but I already love Michigan! 💕 Driving to St. Ignace tomorrow. #Michigan #lakesuperior
#upperpeninsula
#greatlakes
sleeping on the lake michigan beach in the dead of winter
When I tell you that the idea of diving into frozen Lake Michigan sounded more attractive than working another minute today….
this morning along Lake Michigan, just me, one jogger, and the waterfowl enjoying/enduring the freeze.
Lake Michigan was beautiful today - Taken from Oval Beach in Saugatuck Amazing that today it looks like the arctic, and in a few months we’ll be tanning and swimming in 85 degrees
Drove to Lake Michigan to see how frozen it was, pretty frozen 😉😁

Lake Michigan has been rough for two weeks but today we were finally able to get back in! Water temp is down to 43 so we didn’t stay long. And I nearly slipped on a patch of icy sand making my way to the water! #coldwater
The weather was calm and comfortable enough on the walk over to the lake tonight, but I caught a chilly lake breeze the moment I crossed Sheridan. The days are getting longer but not fast enough!
Stopped by Montrose Beach for a winter gear check & to look at the banks of steam on Lake Michigan. Saw a snow bunting. Did not stay long.
I somehow got talked into swimming in Lake Michigan later today, so if I freeze to death it was nice knowing all of you

Double digit run along a (for the time being) still frozen lake. I liked it better last week when it was 8°F and there were fewer people on the Peninsula. 😉 Also, the last picture is my reaction to the dozen people competing for first place in the Darwin Awards by walking out on the ice dunes...

.bsky.social hi george. I have a couple of friends in NZ for their honeymoon but don’t precisely where. They have been there a couple of weeks already and will return to the USA the first week of February, the worst time of winter in Cleveland/Lake Erie Ohio
Me on Lake Michigan during the next freeze:
Greetings from the north, where I walked on a frozen Lake Michigan today.
We drove along the Lake Michigan shore earlier today. Snow and Ice. C'mon Spring!
Very relatable. My number 1 reason for going to UWMadison was the weather & Lake Michigan.
I'd say everywhere, Lake Michigan! Live!, these are the current conditions everywhere.
Heyyyyy Jaye! What a glorious picture. I definitely feel like riding the waves! Not enough of them here on Lake Michigan lol
Caseville beach trip today! (Don’t worry, the storm offshore moved away quickly.)

in t-minus four days I will be sitting on tropical beach and I'm so frickin excited 🌴🌞 I literally have not taken a vacation in two years and haven't been to a beach that wasn't on one of the great lakes in probably 12 years. I am so ready to escape the cold north for a little while

I don't mind the cold or snow of West Michigan, but I wish I had scheduled more than one beach day this year. I was just deleting files to make room for storage on my phone when I found these pics. Winter won't last forever and there are more outdoorsy days to come. #puremichigan #lakemichigan
Wind, waves, and warm water. A beautiful day on Lake Michigan!
Beautiful! Where? Here, Lake Michigan is starting to freeze.

Live fearlessly. Except for the ice fishing part. I live in Michigan and have spent a little time chasing my boyfriend (now husband of 46 years) along a discarded Christmas tree lined path on Saginaw Bay (Lake Huron). Cold, boring, weird sport.
Here I am on a small private beach on Lake Superior last September. The weather was beautiful but the water was cold!
A frozen Lake Michigan, with the snowy lake merging with clouds. Only 6 degrees now. 🥶
The winter sky over a frozen and snowy Lake Huron. For you.
The first dusting of the white stuff ❄️ on my backyard beach umbrella on the shores of Lake Huron. Bring it in December!

Cold, beautiful day at the beach last weekend. Lake Michigan at Union Pier, MI.
❤
one summer we took a week and drove the whole way around Lake Michigan, including swimming Superior because there was a heat wave!
Such a lovely mild day here in #Toronto, decided to take the "pup" and stroll along the boardwalk (The Beaches)

I do too! My favorite winter beach is up on Lake Ontario, right across from Toronto. I just took a 4 mile walk with my dog: wind chill -6. It was sunny today which made it feel a little better. I have all the gear for cold weather so will head out sometime this week and take some photos.
Beautiful day at Edgewater finally feels like spring 🌱
Finally went to Lake Michigan for the first time. Water is FREEZING

Would love a warm beach and hot sun right now ☀️😎
Pancake Bay ~ Lake Superior

Lake Michigan during the small periods of sun today. It was windy & the shore was deserted. I really enjoyed what could have been a totally cloudy, grey day that turned out to be stunning. Feeling blessed.
It’s as cold as it looks but I have the beach to myself #lakeontario
Awesome!! Can’t wait to see u chillin on Lake Michigan 😎
Have a great trip. We were at Holland Michigan a couple of weeks ago. Lake Michigan water was cold.

Stunningly beautiful places to be sure, but you're not swimming in ice water when you go to Florida. 🥶 I should add, I'd rather freeze my ass off in Lake Michigan or Superior over Florida any day of the week (unless those weeks are November thru April).
Damn did you go to Antarctica? Or is this just lake Michigan
Walking on frozen Lake Michigan is the coolest
I was walking to Lake Michigan last night and I was all bundled up except my legs, which were frozen. And I thought “surely this is body sculpting”
love being on Lake Michigan when the ice looks like this — it’s just so beautiful and peaceful

It was a cold but beautiful day spent with my family in Racine, Wisconsin.
I will always cherish the memories Lake Michigan holds in my heart.
Lake Michigan, at Rocky Gap Beach. 3/14/25 and 78 degrees. Still some big sand covered ice ridges to melt, but it’s nice to see open water.
West Michigan today, still quite a bit of ice on Lake Michigan, but damn!! What a gorgeous day!!
drove out to the beach after work and walked down the breakwater. not a single cloud in the sky but it was quite chilly! lake michigan is awesome when the water churns and crashes like that.
Lake Michigan. It was cold.., a little bit...
20 years ago, I went to a wedding in Mobile in June and dang near melted. 72 hours later i was on Lake Michigan and almost cold.
How's the water? Been thinking about having a beach day soon but lake michigan stays freezing cold for so long

Haha. It's been quite rainy here recently. But if you're a diver or surfer it'd be great right now. And Maldives is open 24/7, 365 days a year so you're welcome anytime. I lived around The Great Lakes for a while, so I learned to love the snow. 😄👍🏾🙏🏾

I dipped my feet into the Pacific Ocean for the first time last night. Hot take: Atlantic > Pacific. If not for the surf possibilities I’d say it’s tied with Lake Michigan. It’s so cold! The beaches near my home are warmer than the Pacific, and they freeze over every year!

In the winter I used to go clubbing/dancing on Rush Street which is about parallel to the Lake Michigan shoreline. No coats. Wearing high heels. I would now immediately turn into a popsicle -- but have great memories.
Awesome! What a difference two weeks makes right? I was still able to wade out into Lake Michigan then. Yesterday? Not so much. Brrrr. 🙂
That there is any real juice near lake michigan on February is amazing to me.
I have been obsessed with Lake Michigan for over thirty years but this weekend is the first time I have enjoyed lake effect snow. It’s so beautiful.
I have just been viewing images of the frozen Lake Michigan. I want to be there! Beautiful work, Champion x.

San Fernando Valley native, here. I was at Great Lakes NTC for the winter 40 years ago and recall standing at parade rest in a skirt with a brutal wind sweeping off of Lake Michigan and all I can say is have fun, ICE your boss has excellent timing
brb I need to take a walk into Lake Michigan just to cool myself off for a lil bit
Very cool and normal planet we have here when we can go for a very comfortable evening dip in Lake Michigan near the end of September
Arcadia Dunes Preserve, Lake Michigan this week. I stood here in September. It was warmer then, but I'm guessing just as windy.
December beach. Lake Michigan at St. Joseph, MI.
Lake Michigan on a clear, frigid day. I love the way the waves crash in and leave a tiny icy transformed part of themselves behind.
I was in Racine right on the Lake Michigan shoreline, it was freezing because it was February. The wind was coming off the lake like crazy!
lake michigan a few days before the cold snap, I’ll have to walk down tomorrow to see how much has froze over
Lake Michigan in gentle pastels on an especially frigid day.
Today's weather is similar to the day I beached a 52 foot sailing ship on a sandbar on Lake Superior. Ah, memories.
I travel to Lake Michigan to see the ice every year… it’s beyond amazing!!
Lake Michigan for me. It’s ice cold all year long.
Lake Superior on a chilly May evening. Michigan is so beautiful.
I'm on the west side-good ol' Lake Michigan lake effect! Generally love it, but loved it MORE when snow days were an option! 😂😂
Ice-rimmed Lake Superior beach. Warmer than the last two days at least!
Pere Marquette, Lake Michigan. 93 degrees and Sunny. Me and my boy enjoying the white caps rolling in.

We honeymooned in Niagra Falls in early May, and let me just say I had to adjust my expectations for the botanical garden. 😅 We HAD just gotten married on the shores of Lake Erie, so in my defense, I knew it would be cold!
I remember we went to the Indiana Dunes last year in October and that wind off of Lake Michigan was no joke. I know them November - February months are more brutal lol
also it was a really nice day out even by my grass-averse standards and we were by Lake Michigan so the breeze was nice.

I went to Uni on the Great Lakes. I can’t complain about weather. At least not rain ☔️ My husband is a Brummie and even HE admits Manchester is a great city. He says he didn’t want to like it here so much but he does lol
